q: The electricity generated at the power station is transmitted to the consumers through the power ____.
e: The electricity generated at the power station is transmitted to the consumers through the power cables. Power station is transmitted to the consumers through the power ____. cables. A nearby word in place of cables would name a different quantity.

q: Power loss is one of the main problems in the long distance ____ of electricity.
e: Power loss is one of the main problems in the long distance transmission of electricity. Of the main problems in the long distance ____ of electricity. transmission. A nearby word in place of transmission would name a different quantity.

q: If it is transmitted through the power cables, which may have a resistance of 1 ohm per kilometre, then the amount of electrical power lost as ____ in 1 km of transmission line will be given by Power loss = $I^2 R$.
e: If it is transmitted through the power cables, which may have a resistance of 1 ohm per kilometre, then the amount of electrical power lost as heat in 1 km of transmission line will be given by Power loss = I^2 R. Resistance opposes current and turns electrical energy into heat. Electrical power is the energy transfer rate, P = VI, also I^2R or V^2/R.

q: One way to reduce power loss is to use very thick cables of low ____.
e: One way to reduce power loss is to use very thick cables of low resistance. Resistance opposes current and turns electrical energy into heat. Power loss is to use very thick cables of low ____. resistance.

q: A more practical way would be to reduce the magnitude of the transmission current by stepping up the ____.
e: A more practical way would be to reduce the magnitude of the transmission current by stepping up the voltage. Voltage is potential difference, energy per unit charge between two points. Current is charge passing a point each second, and it needs a closed path.

q: The national grid system is used to distribute ____ around the country.
e: The national grid system is used to distribute electricity around the country. The national grid system is used to distribute ____ around the country. electricity. A nearby word in place of electricity would name a different quantity.

q: An advantage of the grid system is power stations in areas where the demand is low can be used to supply areas where the demand is ____.
e: An advantage of the grid system is power stations in areas where the demand is low can be used to supply areas where the demand is high. Can be used to supply areas where the demand is ____. high. A nearby word in place of high would name a different quantity.

q: First, an alternating current is generated at high voltage from the power station, the voltage is then stepped up for transmission and finally stepped down at the ____ in stages.
e: First, an alternating current is generated at high voltage from the power station, the voltage is then stepped up for transmission and finally stepped down at the substations in stages. Current is charge passing a point each second, and it needs a closed path. AC reverses on a clock; household supply is this reversing current.
